rows: Counter resolution and type
16-bit up, down, up/down autoreload counter
16-bit up, down, up/down autoreload counter
Prescaler factor
16-bit programmable prescaler, allowing the division (also "on the fly") of the counter clock frequency, by any factor between 1 and 65536
16-bit programmable prescaler, allowing the division (also "on the fly") of the counter clock frequency, by any factor between 1 and 65536
Channels
Up to six independent channels for: • Input capture (channels 5 and 6) • Output compare • PWM generation (edge- and center- aligned modes) combined PWM mode: 1 and 2 • One-pulse mode output
Up to seven independent channels for: • Input capture (channels 5, 6 and 7) • Output compare • PWM generation (edge- and center- aligned modes) combined PWM mode: 1 to 4 • One-pulse mode output
Synchronization with external signals and general‑purpose timers

• Synchronization circuit to control the timer with external signals and to interconnect several timers together • The advanced-control (TIM1/TIM8) and general-purpose (TIMy) timers are completely independent, and do not share any resources

• Synchronization circuit to control the timer with external signals and to interconnect several timers together • The advanced-control (TIM1/TIM8) and general-purpose (TIMy) timers are completely independent, and do not share any resources
Break inputs
Two break inputs to put the timer's output signals in reset state or in a known state
Two break inputs to put the timer's output signals in reset state or in a known state featuring delayed break.
